topic: Tool-arg defaulting completion: pin population, ambient-default expansion, cwd name flip
notes:
Peeled from thread-36f3cced. The mechanism is live (w11 skinny-brodex build: ToolArgDefaults table, default/pin grammar, riders, schema validation; proving default mcp.bbox_note.session_id verified in prod). Design contract: design/bro-harness/tool-arg-defaulting.md — bump its lifecycle to partial when picking this up. Remaining:

1. PIN POPULATION (step 5 full form): fleet/workflow worktree creation should emit `pin:*.project_dir=<worktree>` (and the workflow op its arc worktree) so a confused model passing the wrong tree gets a refusal with explanation — the wrong-tree class dies completely. The pin flavor is implemented and tested; only the daemon-side population is missing.

2. AMBIENT-DEFAULT EXPANSION (decision-gated by §3.1 scope semantics): broaden beyond bbox_note.session_id — thread_id/work_item for bbox_thread continue, task_id for bro_report. The project/scope params are the deliberate exclusion: `project: None` means GLOBAL scope on knowledge/note tools, so defaulting it silently converts intended-global writes — needs an explicit operator decision per tool, not a sweep.

3. CWD ADVERTISED-NAME FLIP: dispatch params currently advertise project_dir and accept cwd as alias (830c2c0); the design names cwd canonical (contract-bottom name). Flip the schema-advertised name + migrate tool docs/prompts/atom templates in one pass so model priors and docs agree.

4. (minor, from thread-9dfe1da5 closeout) BRO_HARNESS_COMPACTION_CONFIG provider-catalog wiring remains optional/unpursued — model-keyed defaults suffice for in-process dispatch; revisit only if a per-dispatch window override is ever actually needed.

Thread triage 2026-06-11: items 1 and 3 extracted to repo-owned gaps for cross-machine pickup — item 1 pin population → gap-8144b4b5 (tooling/dispatch/worktree-pin-population), item 3 cwd advertised-name flip → gap-6366c92d (tooling/dispatch/cwd-advertised-name-flip). Thread stays OPEN as the umbrella: item 2 (ambient-default expansion) is operator-decision-gated on §3.1 scope semantics (project:None means GLOBAL on knowledge/note tools — defaulting it silently converts intended-global writes) and item 4 (BRO_HARNESS_COMPACTION_CONFIG catalog wiring) is optional/unpursued. Whoever picks up the gaps should resolve them via bbox_gap_resolve and note completion here.

All four items now live as repo-owned project gaps or are explicitly dropped: item 1 pin population → gap-8144b4b5; item 2 ambient-default expansion → gap-ae22a6b2 (decision-gated, pickup contract in the gap notes); item 3 cwd advertised-name flip → gap-6366c92d; item 4 compaction-config catalog wiring → deliberately not filed (optional/unpursued per thread-9dfe1da5 closeout).
